summary_en: SANKI ENGINEERING raised interim dividend to 42.50 yen per share (from 32.50 yen) and revised full-year dividend forecast to 85.00 yen per share (from 65.00 yen) for fiscal year ending March 2027, reflecting better-than-expected earnings performance.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend Payment (Interim Dividend) and Revision of Full-Year Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, SANKI ENGINEERING's board of directors approved an interim dividend of 42.50 yen per share for the fiscal year ending March 2027, compared to the previously forecasted 32.50 yen, representing an increase of 10 yen. The company simultaneously revised its full-year dividend forecast, raising the projected year-end dividend from 32.50 yen to 85.00 yen per share. This brings total annual dividends to 85.00 yen per share, up 20 yen from the prior forecast of 65.00 yen.

The dividend increase reflects stronger-than-expected earnings performance for the period. The company disclosed revised earnings forecasts on the same date, indicating results exceeding earlier projections announced on August 7, 2026. Under its Medium-Term Management Plan 2027 (initiated in fiscal 2025), SANKI ENGINEERING targets a pure asset dividend rate (DOE) of 5% or above and plans to acquire approximately 12 million shares through the plan period as its fundamental capital allocation policy.

Note: The company executed a 3-for-1 stock split effective May 1, 2026. Prior-year dividend figures are shown on a pre-split basis, while current-year forecasts and results reflect post-split share counts.
